Package controller

Class AuthenticationController

java.lang.Object
controller.AuthenticationController
public class AuthenticationController extends Object
Implements the AuthenticationController from the SRS class diagram (Figure 6): verifyCredentials, resetPassword, generateSessionToken. Also enforces the brute-force lockout policy from SRS 4.2 Robustness (5 failed attempts -> 15 minute lockout).

    • login

      public AuthResult login(String username, String password)
      Authenticates a username/password pair, applying account lockout and suspension checks. Never reveals whether the failure was due to an unknown username or a wrong password (avoids user enumeration).
